shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a long rectangular island stands between the refrigerator wall and the sink area, with stools arranged along its sides. A woman in a red shirt sits on the sink-side guest stool and asks who will handle the morning housekeeping and breakfast, a woman in a green shirt sits on the refrigerator-side guest stool, and a man in an orange shirt sits on the sink-end stool.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the refrigerator end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the sink area, with both guest-side stools and the sink-end stool in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a red shirt on the sink-side guest stool exchanges seats with a woman in a green shirt on the refrigerator-side guest stool, who offers to cook while the first agrees to manage the cleaning work.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the cook side, centered on the two adjacent guest-side stools.

shots.content: A woman in a red shirt announces that the kitchen work is finished.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the sink end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the refrigerator wall, with both guest-side stools and the sink-end stool in frame.
